hooks.command: if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '(^|/)\.env(\.|$)' | grep -vE '\.env\.example$' >&2; then echo 'BLOCK: .env file staged - unstage it before committing' >&2; exit 2; fi

echo '{"systemMessage": "Workflow checklist (significant changes only — skip for CSS tweaks, type fixes, minor cosmetic changes): (1) tests added/updated, (2) docs updated if needed, (3) detailed commit, (4) PR opened and merged to main."}'
